description: This file contains utility functions related to reporting in SuiteCRM, including date calculations, module field display, and request parameter processing.

methods.name: getDisplayForField
methods.description: Generates display labels and types for a module path and field, resolving related modules and label translations.

methods.name: requestToUserParameters
methods.description: Converts request parameters into formatted user parameters for report filtering.

methods.name: getConditionsAsParameters
methods.description: Transforms report conditions into parameter arrays for report generation.

methods.name: getPeriodDate
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object representing the start date for a given period string.

methods.name: getPeriodEndDate
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object representing the end date for a given period string.

methods.name: calculateQuarters
methods.description: Calculates the date boundaries of the four quarters of a year, with optional offset months.

methods.name: convertToDateTime
methods.description: Converts a date string in user format to a normalized DateTime object in UTC.
